rework.closure:
Appended a 24-line, purely additive '### Amendment note (v1.2, task 21.11: SEC-21.5-02 and SEC-21.5-03)' to docs/decisions/ADR-020.md (between the task 15.4 amendment note and '### Rejected alternatives'); no existing clause or note text was edited, and no source, test, changelog, architecture, README, PLANS, other-ADR, manifest, artifact, or release-state file was changed. Exact appended wording (the inserted block, whose trailing blank separator line makes git's 24-added-line count):

### Amendment note (v1.2, task 21.11: SEC-21.5-02 and SEC-21.5-03)

The clause 4 redaction contract above is unchanged; no clause or note above is
rewritten. This note records the task 21.11 correction to the shipped **bounded
log subject**, which makes two reading-level statements in the task 15.4
amendment note above stale (that note described the then-shipped code):

- **Final-component extraction (SEC-21.5-03).** The final path component is
  extracted on both `/` and `\` independently of the host platform, so a
  Windows-style or UNC primary path no longer yields a single whole string, and
  the directory/share/account chain is excluded on every host.
- **Removal predicate (SEC-21.5-02).** The removal predicate is the
  non-printing set `Cc`, `Cf`, `Zl`, and `Zp`, not `Cc` only; every other
  category is preserved. The 128-scalar bound applied after removal, the
  scalar-wise pass that never splits a surrogate pair, and the item-identifier
  fallback are unchanged.

The old "`Path.GetFileName`" / "host-native-path" reading and the "control
scalars removed" reading in the task 15.4 amendment note above are therefore
superseded by the ADR-026 implementation note for task 21.11; the current
wording is in `docs/architecture/12-performance-and-operational-limits.md` and
in that note. The release security review of the corrected candidate (task
21.14) owns the disposition of both findings.
